summary: Eight-metre kerb beside a house, 9 m away, at a junction.

drivers.seclusion: Dwelling 9 m from the kerb at the start; houses on both sides; overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Eight metres of kerb beside the junction mouth with parked cars along it; no room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Junction with a through street, turning cars.
drivers.convention: Cars park nearby; signs are 2P resident permit Mon-Fri 7am-6pm.

sun_shade: Tree canopy on the east and south sides; open to the north.
